name: HoLEP versus TURP (Tauranga)
question: How do HoLEP and TURP compare for symptoms, flow, obstruction, and retreatment in men with larger obstructing prostates?

arms.label: Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate

design.population: Men with urodynamically confirmed bladder outlet obstruction from BPH, transrectal ultrasound prostate volume 40–200 g, AUA symptom score at least 8, maximum flow at most 15 mL/s, postvoid residual less than 400 mL, and Schaffer grade at least 2.
design.locator: Wilson 2006, journal p570, Methods; p571, Table 1 and Results

verdictNote: No 24-month primary difference; six-month urodynamic measures favored HoLEP.
takeaway: HoLEP and TURP had no significant difference in symptom score, quality of life, or maximum flow at 24 months in men with 40–200 g obstructing prostates. HoLEP produced greater urodynamic relief at six months and shorter catheterization and hospitalization.
